workload.note: Down year vs. rookie season: only two 95+-yard receiving games in 2025 vs. four such games as a rookie in 2024.
Rookie season described as having four 95+-receiving-yard games (more explosive than 2025); exact full stat line not captured in sources searched.

contract.note: Chargers exercised McConkey's fifth-year option for 2026 (per Chargers.com camp preview).

scheme.note: McDaniel (former Dolphins HC) hired as Chargers OC for 2026, emphasizing quick throws arriving in 2.4 seconds or less; McDaniel reportedly expects receivers to exceed career highs in this scheme. McConkey quote on the new scheme: 'Just watching practice, watching the scheme, I'm like, "I can't wait to get out there."'

competition.name: Tre' Harris
competition.note: Second-year receiver, part of the same WR competition group.

notes: McConkey quote on 2026 goals: 'Catch it and get vertical. Get forward... Let's turn an 11 yards-per-catch average into 15 or 16,' referencing 2025's 11.9 yards/catch (789 yds / 66 rec) as something to improve on.
SI Chargers piece frames McConkey as 'the most obvious bounce-back season candidate' for 2026 after a down 2025.
